# ankra_mcp_tool_grant (Resource)

Grants one tool of an MCP server to one organisation role. The counterpart of `ankra org mcp-servers grant` and `revoke-grant`. Changes need the `ai.manage` permission.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "ankra_mcp_tool_grant" "find_issues" {
  server_id = ankra_mcp_server.sentry.id
  tool_name = "find_issues"
  role      = "member"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `server_id` (String) MCP server id.
- `tool_name` (String) Tool name as the server lists it, at most 160 characters, without `/`.

### Optional

- `role` (String) Organisation role slug the tool is granted to, as `ankra org roles` lists it. Omitted, it is `member`, and the platform treats a `member` grant as granted to every role. The platform accepts any string and a grant to a role that does not exist grants nothing, so the provider checks the role against the organisation's roles at creation (skipped, with a warning, when the provider token cannot list roles).

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Grant id.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Tool grants are imported by "<server_id>/<role>/<tool_name>".
terraform import ankra_mcp_tool_grant.find_issues 9a0e7c34-0000-0000-0000-000000000000/member/find_issues
```
